name: acc_ops_stop_restart
description:
req-vd-ad:REQ-AD-031 step a. ACC on + SET at t=1.0, then the driver does NOTHING until an accelerator pulse at t=21.0-22.0. The long empty stretch is the point: it is the window in which the function must bring the car to a halt behind the stopping lead and HOLD it there, with the only evidence that it is holding being that the car does not move (stop_hold_stationary) while gt.acc.stop_hold reads true. The pulse is the ONLY restart trigger -- 段a defines restart as a human action and the controller never decides to restart on its own, so a run where the lead pulls away and the car follows would be a defect, not a success.

PULSE TIME MEASURED, NOT GUESSED. The first phase-C probe run put it at t=16.0 and the run never held at all: the ego was still rolling at 1.2 m/s at t=15.8 (measurement in GT_esmini/docs/virtualdriver/measurements/manualdrive_creep_stop_hold_2026-08-05.md), so the 'restart' happened before there was anything to restart from and the scenario silently measured an accelerator override instead of a Stop&Go release. t=21.0 leaves the hold several seconds to engage and be observed as a settled state.

Throttle 0.35 for the pulse: above restart_accel_threshold (0.10) with margin, below kickdown_threshold (0.95) so the shared kickdown latch stays out of this scenario entirely. Held for a full second rather than a single frame so the restart is unambiguous at any dt the batch might use.
